title: Pricing | Norvik Analytics
description: Demand forecasting plans for retailers. Save with annual billing.
markdown:
# Pricing

Demand forecasting for retailers of every size. Prices in USD.

## Starter

**$290/month** billed annually ($350 billed monthly)

- Up to 5 stores
- Weekly forecasts
- Email support

## Growth

**$890/month** billed annually ($1,090 billed monthly)

- Up to 50 stores
- Daily store- and SKU-level forecasts
- Promotions and weather signals
- Shared Slack support channel

## Enterprise

Custom pricing for unlimited stores, on-premise connectors and a dedicated forecasting analyst. [Talk to sales](https://www.norvikanalytics.com/contact)

---

Prices updated October 1, 2026.

# Introducing our new plans

*March 4, 2025*

From today, Norvik Analytics comes in two plans. **Starter** is $240/month billed annually for up to 5 stores, and **Growth** is **$690/month** billed annually for up to 30 stores.

Existing customers keep their price until renewal.
